svg.title: TYPE_MOVE_AGV -> PlanAgvMoveJob()
svg.desc: Two MOVE_AGV jobs in one request. An empty AGV produces an AgvMove; an AGV that is carrying a tray produces a TrayMove whose AGV is already fixed.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Job 0: empty DAG. Job 1: replays event 1, so AGV-1 is already at W13. (replay)", "Row 2. Refuse jobs that do not name an AGV. Choosing an AGV for the caller is not implemented (a TODO). In this example: Both jobs name an AGV. Moving 'any AGV' is a TODO. (passes)", "Row 3. Look the AGV up in the scratch garage; a missing or disabled AGV cannot be moved. In this example: AGV-1 and AGV-2 exist and are enabled. (passes)", "Row 4. If the AGV already stands at the destination pose, succeed without adding anything. In this example: Neither AGV is at its destination. (no early exit)", "Row 5. Describe the move as current pose -> destination, then check the destination exists in the graph and is not disabled for an AGV in this state (empty or carrying a tray). In this example: The collision entity depends on whether the AGV carries a tray. W13 and P24 are enabled. (passes)", "Row 6. Optional shortcut: if the caller allows the reverse heading and the headings are the same or opposite, keep the AGV where it is. In this example: Plan() and PlanAgvChargeJob() both pass false, so this branch never runs (and would turn the move into a no-op if it did). (never taken)", "Row 7. An AGV without a tray gets one AgvMove, chained after the AGV's previous event (rule A). In this example: Job 0: AGV-1 is empty. AGV-1 has no earlier event, so rule A adds no edge. (adds 1)", "Row 8. An AGV carrying a tray moves the tray with it: create a TrayMove with this AGV already assigned, convert the destination to the tray's heading and apply the parking-heading policy; chain after the tray's last event. In this example: Job 1: AGV-2 carries T9. The destination is converted from AGV to tray heading, then the parking heading policy may change it. (adds 2)", "Row 9. Make the new event wait for any earlier events of the same job (rule B). In this example: Each job has only one event: no rule B edge. (no edge)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): event 1. AGV-1 drives W26 -> W25 -> W22 -> W18 -> W13.", "Playing the plan: event 2. AGV-2 carries T9 W18 -> W22 -> P23 -> P24 and lowers it. No approach drive: T9 was already on AGV-2. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
